blocks.text: Setting up your Notion workspace on Mac

The first step for any content strategist is ensuring your Notion desktop app is optimized. Download the official app for macOS 13 or later. Keep your workspace clean by nesting pages logically. Use a top level page for your main content hub. Add subpages for your content calendar, brand guidelines, and current audit projects.

items: Use ⌘ + P to open the search bar and jump between pages instantly.
Type / to open the block menu for adding tables, headers, or images.
Press ⌘ + B to bold text during your drafting process.
Use ⌘ + ⇧ + 7 to create a numbered list quickly.

blocks.text: A content calendar needs to be visible and actionable. Create a database view that shows your content by status. Use the board view to visualize your workflow from drafting to final publication. You can filter this view to show only your assigned tasks. This keeps your focus on what matters today.
Use a date property in your database to set reminders. This ensures you never miss a deadline for a critical content piece.
blocks.title: Keep deadlines visible

blocks.text: Auditing a website requires tracking many data points. Import your existing CSV files directly into a Notion database. Create properties for URL, word count, SEO status, and priority. This allows you to sort and filter your audit data without switching to Excel or Google Sheets.

Lazur helps you stay in the flow while working in Notion on your Mac. Hold ⌥ ⌘ to ask about a specific setting or how to use a feature. Lazur can point to the correct menu item or guide you through creating a complex formula property. Use it to dictate your notes directly into your strategy docs.

faq.question: Is the Notion desktop app available for all Mac versions?
faq.answer: The official Notion desktop app requires macOS 13 or later. Always check for updates in the Notion menu.

faq.question: Can I use custom keyboard shortcuts in Notion?
faq.answer: Notion does not support custom key bindings. You must use the built-in shortcuts provided by the app.
